name: codex-capacity-guard
description: Wait for the original model and resume local Codex conversations after temporary capacity errors.

interface.shortDescription: Automatically wait and resume after model capacity errors.
interface.longDescription: An independent local watcher that retries capacity-failed conversations with the same model and original thread settings. No retry-count limit. Enable or disable explicitly.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Capacity Guard to check compatibility and enable recovery for model capacity errors.
